title: Experimentum Sitis
intro: Communitas, cupiditate ducis ad causam suam defendendam, postulavit ut dux sibi praeficeretur. Postulatione exaudita, electus cum dubitatione exceptus est, quia hic homo non eam dignitatem mundanam quam exspectabant possidebat. Ante ultimum certamen, hic novus dux ipsam disciplinam exercitus simplici, sed gravi, experimento moderationis experiri debebat.
clues: Dux creatus sum postquam populus meus ducem postulavit qui pro causa Allah pugnaret.
Multi e meis initio designationem meam in dubium vocaverunt, divitiarum mearum inopiam et nobilitatis genus commemorantes.
Electus sum quia Allah mihi abundantiam scientiae et staturam corporis robustam dederat.
Signum perspicuum designationis meae divinae fuit reditus Arcae Foederis, ab angelis portatae, quae pacem cordibus credentium attulit.
Dum cum militibus meis procedebam, nuntiavi nos ad flumen experturos esse.
Exercitui meo imperavi ne quicumque ex flumine multum biberet ex mea cohorte esset, dum qui unum tantum cochleare in manu sumpsissent, manerent.

trial.label: Quod erat meum principale iudicium?
options: Aedificantes munimentum contra Gog et Magog
Gigante in singulari certamine obviam eundo

location.label: Quod signum clavem auctoritatis meae erat?
options: Baculus qui in serpentem conversus est

outcome.label: Quid fuit exitus expeditionis meae?
options: Rubrum Mare Dividens ut tyrannum effugiat

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
